crease.question: How visible is the crease?
crease.view1: Hold the Duo flat and look straight at the crease.

debug.title: Debug Info
faq.battery.a: Apple does not provide battery health data to third-party apps. Only Settings > Battery can show this information.
faq.battery.q: Why can't FoldCheck read battery health?
faq.folds.a: The fold counter only tracks folds while FoldCheck is running in the foreground. Apple doesn't expose a lifetime fold count to apps.
faq.hinge.a: The hinge test checks for smooth, continuous angle readings. Gaps or inconsistencies may indicate sensor issues, but could also be normal variation.
faq.hinge.q: Why does the hinge test show Attention?
faq.otherDevice.a: Yes. The signature will show as an unknown key, but it still verifies the PDF wasn't modified. Each FoldCheck installation has its own signing key.
faq.otherDevice.q: Can I verify a report from another device?
faq.signature.a: It proves the PDF hasn't been edited after creation by that specific FoldCheck installation. It does NOT prove device authenticity.
faq.signature.q: What does the digital signature prove?
folds.disclaimer: Counted only while FoldCheck is open in the foreground. This is not the device’s lifetime fold count: iOS doesn’t let apps read that.
folds.notApplicable: This device has no hinge, so there are no folds to count.
folds.title: Folds observed by FoldCheck
hinge.holdInstruction: Fold the Duo to about 90°, tap Start hold, then keep it still for 5 seconds.
hinge.manualNote: Some angles were entered with the on-screen slider, not read from the hinge.
hinge.noReadings: No hinge readings yet. Move the hinge, or use the slider below.
hinge.rangeNote: Apple doesn’t document the hinge’s angle range, so the observed range is reported as-is and never judged.
hinge.sweepInstruction: Close slowly to about 20°, then open slowly until flat.
hinge.unavailableMessage: FoldCheck didn’t get enough hinge angles to judge the hinge. This isn’t a hinge fault. Try again, or finish and the test is marked Unavailable.

pixels.instructions: Each screen is one solid color. Tap any spot where a pixel looks dead, stuck, or discolored, then tap Next.
pixels.note: The user marked %d spots that looked dead, stuck, or discolored.
pixels.tip: Brightness goes to maximum during the test and is restored after. Turn off True Tone and Night Shift for accurate colors.
report.disclaimer: DISCLAIMER: This report is a user-generated inspection snapshot created by FoldCheck. It is NOT an official certification from Apple or any authorized service provider. The digital signature proves only that this PDF has not been modified since creation by this specific FoldCheck installation. It does not verify device authenticity, ownership, or repair history. FoldCheck cannot access battery health, cycle counts, serial numbers, or lifetime fold counts. The fold counter tracks only folds observed while the app was running in the foreground. Hinge test results reflect continuity and consistency of angle readings, not absolute mechanical accuracy. Use this report as supplementary information only.
